123d6375-8cfe-4738-859d-7c752f2644bb: Patients who are allergic to penicillin have a risk of allergic reactions to cephalexin. 71d6f392-0b31-4f52-afa2-0432bf6edc25: Cardiac ablation has risks, including bleeding or infection at the catheter site, damage to blood vessels, puncture of the heart, damage to heart valves, damage to the electrical system of the heart possibly requiring a pacemaker, blood clots, stroke or heart attack, narrowing of veins between lungs and heart, damage to kidneys from dye used in procedure, and in rare cases, death. 0db9c734-b48d-41fd-8266-ab0c63aa02a9: Fildena, like Viagra, is a medication used to treat erectile dysfunction. 5a3fc217-0680-44fd-9221-371d7d606585: The diagnosis of normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) can be challenging because its symptoms of gait disturbance, mild dementia, and poor bladder control can overlap with other health conditions that affect people over 60. 97c7958f-20e6-41de-aca0-c89429d7d81e: Hepatitis is transmitted through various ways depending on the type: Hepatitis A is transmitted through consumption of contaminated water or food or through certain sex practices; Hepatitis B and C are mainly transmitted through exposure to infective blood, semen, and other body fluids, through transfusions of contaminated blood, contaminated injections during medical procedures, and through injection drug use; Hepatitis D occurs only in those already infected with Hepatitis B; Hepatitis E is mainly transmitted through consumption of contaminated water or food. 4984bf18-c36d-4647-b2bb-051f7da1a1d7: Jock itch, also known as tinea cruris, usually impacts the area around the upper thigh and doesn't typically involve the scrotum or penis. f33b779d-7ecb-4128-bbeb-917b6d699c17: The causes of rib cage pain may include a bruised, cracked, or fractured rib, inflammation of the cartilage near the breastbone (costochondritis), osteoporosis, or pleurisy. 9001a23a-3be0-430c-8b6f-28ad0fa49644: Hantavirus is a severe infection that can rapidly deteriorate. It can cause lung failure and potentially lead to death. 8aa816c6-e418-420b-a52a-55bfa501039c: Not every patient with appendicitis experiences an elevated temperature. d4709e2b-f9e9-4c0f-aae2-02aea9685d11: Scabies, a condition characterized by an infestation of mites, is usually spread via direct, prolonged skin-to-skin contact with infected individuals or through exposure to infested clothing, bedding or furniture. d7f7d8da-dc41-4403-8b6c-a8ca00dce4a9: Alcohol should not be mixed with medicines as it can intensify their effects and make activities like driving dangerous. 5527f232-fcd4-4dbc-803b-693591937479: Neonatal hypoglycemia occurs when the newborn's blood glucose level is below a safe level for the baby's age, causing symptoms. 0e642bea-8e29-4620-a539-10c9cc85b081: SSPE (subacute sclerosing panencephalitis) is a very rare, but fatal disease of the central nervous system that is a late complication of a measles infection. 142bd28b-dd3d-4c9e-985f-0b7276386085: Hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets can have different patterns of inheritance, including X-linked dominant, X-linked recessive, and autosomal dominant and recessive. 85158c1c-0878-4833-9c3e-334bdaa1f1d8: MTHFR gene mutation, specifically the A1298C mutation, can interfere with the body's ability to break down the amino acid homocysteine. 07e5ee07-2c66-4080-92e5-5eae5d9ea39e: High levels of vitamin D in the blood can be harmful, causing symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, poor appetite, constipation, weakness, confusion, disorientation, heart rhythm problems, and kidney damage. a25dd6ca-493b-42f7-9565-ba5abef6c44c: Shingles is caused by the varicella-zoster virus, which also causes chickenpox. 99d7de50-df22-438d-97aa-a9828c9c18bd: Over-the-counter pain relievers such as ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin IB, etc.) or naproxen sodium (Aleve) can be used for leg pain. d785488b-abc9-4037-808e-aa8dd6c1ce79: People with CVID have a greater chance of developing certain forms of cancer than the general population, including lymphoma and possibly stomach cancer. 42c6dddb-0b13-4965-b502-9f04829675fb: The main types of diabetes are type 1, type 2, prediabetes, and gestational diabetes.
